title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The logo is shown on a visible off-white square background rather than a clearly transparent surround, contrary to the explicit no-white-box requirement.

judge.summary: The square logo has the correct navy name and gold crescent, but the visible off-white background compromises the requested transparent delivery.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: The lettering clearly reads 'Mooncrumb' and is dark navy.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: A gold crescent is centered above the wordmark.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The supplied image visibly has an off-white square surrounding the artwork, rather than a transparent-looking surround.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The visible moon and lettering have complete contours and strokes, with no conspicuous halos or missing sections.
